propositions: Infrastructure plans commit risky runtime-only mechanisms (boot, auth, connectivity, readiness) into slow delivery loops without proving them first through fast local or manual experiments
Existing plan-review criteria lack a built-in overlay that rewards front-loading mechanism validation outside CI/CD pipelines before slow codified delivery cycles

T15 overlay requires naming specific runtime risks, proving each via the fastest available path (local/emulated or manual probe), completing proof before codifying the mechanism, and cleaning up only experiment-scoped artifacts
T10 rubric must partition durable infrastructure from transient de-risk experiments to prevent overlap with T15 de-risk phase
Registry, guide regeneration, and documentation must reflect T15 as a stack-agnostic, self-gating criterion routed by Pass-1 finder alongside other Txx overlays
